title: SC-02 independent exported-asset visual review, repaired pipeline pass

reviewer.method: Inspected every regenerated individual thumbnail against the original brief before consulting regenerated metrics. Builder repair rationale and test results were not used as quality evidence. No implementation source inspected.

objective: A premium production-quality real-time asset library, with at least 25 high-quality individual models targeting 30; recognizable primitive stand-ins alone do not satisfy the brief.

sourceIdentity.limitation: This review binds preserved evidence hashes and snapshot, not a frozen committed product candidate.

priorFindings.evidence: All 30 current thumbnails show visible asset geometry; the blank initial images and initial review are preserved.
Current metrics report finite dimensions/minimum and positive visiblePixelCount for every asset. These observations resolve the pipeline evidence failure, not visual-quality acceptance.

overall.rationale: The repaired catalog is visible, recognizable and stylistically coherent. Eleven assets retain concrete primitive-like construction, missing defining forms, schematic artwork or unfinished material character. The other nineteen show useful authored shapes but the one-view thumbnail packet cannot establish premium close-detail/material, articulation or product-scene quality. Passing counts, finite bounds and load counters do not discharge those requirements.

dimensions.recognizability: Mostly successful at category level; folded-note form is specifically missing and map/chart artwork is under-authored.
dimensions.detailedGeometry: Mixed. Storage cases, chests and several metal props have useful relief and individual parts; sofa/chair/table feet and cloth/paper/decor cases retain visibly schematic construction.
dimensions.proportions: Broad object proportions are generally plausible. Metrics match declared catalog dimensions, but correct real-world scene scale and placement remain untested here.
dimensions.materialResponse: Metallic highlights are visible on compass, spyglass and candelabra; glass transmission is suggested on cabinet/lantern. Most wood, fabric, leather and paper remain broad uniform colors at this scale. Correct PBR response across scene lighting is unproven.
dimensions.normals: No gross inverted or wholly missing surface is apparent in these views. A single view under one setup cannot establish correct normals, backfaces, tangents or hidden-surface shading.
dimensions.consistency: The common dark background, three-quarter framing and color language provide consistent catalog presentation. Small props, especially the key, need closer views because much less screen area shows their details.
dimensions.distinctiveness: The thirty requested named object types are represented by meaningfully different silhouettes; chest variants differ in lid form. The paper assets remain weakly differentiated in their artwork. There is no evidence that the catalog count is achieved through trivial color variants.
dimensions.previewUsefulness: Restored. Current previews support identification; they are insufficient as the only evidence of production quality.

findings.observation: See concrete per-asset observations and repairs. Eleven assets still need visual work before the catalog can meet its premium standard.
findings.requiredRepair: Address the smallest supported modeling/material/artwork scope for these assets; regenerate all affected views and obtain independent re-review.

findings.observation: Each asset has only one 480 x 320 pipeline view. No closer material studies, hidden-surface views, open articulated states or application scene captures were supplied in this pass.
findings.requiredRepair: Provide closer views for small detail/material evaluation, alternate views of relevant surfaces and open states for the drawer/chests/door; include actual application showcase and composed-scene evidence at normal working sizes.

capabilityStatus.catalogCoverage: 30 requested named types across six families are visible; coverage alone does not establish premium quality
capabilityStatus.exportedGLBPipeline: BOUNDED_VISIBLE_SUCCESS: all 30 visible with finite bounds and positive visiblePixelCount
capabilityStatus.premiumAssets: INCOMPLETE: 11 confirmed visual repair cases; remaining 19 require additional quality evidence
capabilityStatus.provenance: MANIFEST_DECLARED_ONLY: AI_ASSISTED original geometry, proprietary license, authorization required, not published; provenance and license source were not audited
capabilityStatus.performance: OBSERVATION_ONLY: regenerated software WebGL timings are approximately 123.7 to 441.1 ms per asset, with 1 to 10 reported calls; no representative product-scene frame-rate, device budget, memory lifecycle or repeatability evidence
capabilityStatus.interaction: NOT_REVIEWED: all articulated props supplied in closed/static states

limitations: This pass evaluates actual exported-GLB thumbnails, not application captures. It cannot grant product-experience, integration, device or owner acceptance.
REVIEW_INCOMPLETE means no specific blocking visual defect was confirmed at supplied scale; it does not mean the asset passed the premium standard.
Stylized geometry is acceptable. Findings address concrete missing defining shapes, conspicuous basic constructions, under-authored graphics or material character; they do not require photorealism.
Static images cannot prove interaction pivots, collision, support attachment, selection, transforms, save/reload or animation cancellation.
The initial failure and second-pass images/metadata are preserved separately; no implementation was edited by this reviewer.
